name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €87.6/MWh on 26 Nov, above the €70 Alert line and 31% higher over three months
state: Dutch TTF gas settled near €87.6/MWh on 26 Nov, 3.7% higher on the week and 30.7% higher over three months, above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). It is about 16% below its 52-week high near €104. Gulf LNG flows remain exposed to the Hormuz disruption, where Iran's Guards said two tankers hit mines on 26 Nov (Deccan Herald).
for_you: High wholesale gas prices feed through to household and business energy bills over the following months. Ofgem's price cap sets most UK household rates.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures (TTF=F)
Deccan Herald (Reuters) — Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two oil tankers hit sea mines near Oman's Khasab

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
